headline: Ebike and mobility device guidance, draft 2027 strategic goals, and a possible bike boulevard workshop are on the agenda.
summary: The meeting will cover city bike and pedestrian projects and grants, plus debriefs on a World Day of Remembrance event and an Ashley Reservoir walk. Other items include website updates, the 2027 meeting schedule, and a possible workshop on bike boulevards.
